decisions.statement: This value is added up over the collection's parts rather than stated on that collection.
Each part's own total length in words is added up.
The parts are the collections naming this one under `part-of-collections`.
A collection no other collection names is worth nothing here.
A part stating no total of its own counts as nought rather than refusing.

definition: how much there is to work through in the collections this one holds, in words
